content:
I would like to have some opinions on how to reorganize seminorms. Currently the files are all over the place: there is Seminorm, Normed/Unbundled/RingSeminorm, and Normed/Group/Seminorm for module, ring, and group seminorms, respectively. The PR #42388 currently moves Seminorm to Normed/Seminorm/Basic and then GroupSeminorm could live in Normed/Seminorm/Group, similar for Ring and generally the files in Unbundled could move to Seminorm.
The second option is to move Seminorm and Normed/Group/Seminorm to Unbundled, which would be less effort.
The third option is have a folder Seminorm with subfolders Group, Ring, and Module mirroring how Normed is structured. This is the option I would prefer currently.

Tagging @Jireh Loreaux @Yaël Dillies @María Inés de Frutos Fernández
I always thought that we should have Normed/{Group,Ring,Module}/Seminorm
#42388 now moves Seminorm to Normed/Module/Seminorm/Basic (and it gets a merge conflict every time something in Seminorm changes)

Since Yael is in favour and nobody else has said anything, can we move forward with this (or have a discussion about how to structure it better)? The PR is getting merge conflicts every time something in Seminorm.lean gets changed, which is easy to fix but somewhat annoying
Oh yes, sorry. I will get to it tonight.
For the record: the PR was merged. Thanks, everybody!
